LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.7: Imitative Speaking

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Imitative Speaking. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how to take care of household items. 1. Why do we need various items in our homes?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify positions of household items in relation to others
2. appreciate use of prepositions in describing positions of objects

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: IMITATIVE SPEAKING
This lesson teaches Imitative Speaking for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify positions of household items in relation to others
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate use of prepositions in describing positions of objects
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Imitative Speaking using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Imitative Speaking above.
2. Explain Imitative Speaking to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Imitative Speaking.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Imitative Speaking with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Imitative Speaking important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to take care of household items. 1. Why do we need various items in our homes?
2. How can we tell the position of an item in the house?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify positions of household items in relation to others
2. appreciate use of prepositions in describing positions of objects

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
